Side BC is divided by D into two segments, of which BD is labeled 4x+9, and DC is labeled 7x-6. raw_record.question_text: Find $x$ if $\overline{AD}$ is a median of $\triangle ABC$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle ABC with D on side BC, where segment BD is labeled 4x+9 and segment DC is labeled 7x-6. From the text, AD is a median of triangle ABC. Use the median rule: a median from A to BC meets BC at its midpoint, so BD = DC. Set 4x+9 = 7x-6 and solve to get x = 5. Ignore the angle label involving y because it is not needed for the median condition.

推理：题目给出 AD 是三角形 ABC 的中线，所以 D 是 BC 的中点，因此 BD = DC。设 4x+9 = 7x-6，移项得 15 = 3x，所以 x = 5。

method.method_draft: Read from the image that BC is split at D into two adjacent parts: BD = 4x+9 and DC = 7x-6. From the text, AD is a median, so D is the midpoint of BC. Instead of immediately equating the two parts, express the whole side as BC = (4x+9)+(7x-6)=11x+3. Since D is the midpoint, each part must equal half of BC; for example, set 4x+9 = (11x+3)/2 and solve, yielding x = 5.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是三角形ABC，点D在边BC上，线段AD从顶点A连到边BC上的点D。边BC被D分成相邻的两段：BD标为4x+9，DC标为7x-6。图中还有一个与y有关的角标注，但求x不需要使用。推理：题目给出AD是三角形ABC的中线，所以D是BC的中点，BD和DC各等于BC的一半。按照指定方法，先求整条边BC=(4x+9)+(7x-6)=11x+3。因为D是中点，所以BD=(BC)/2，即4x+9=(11x+3)/2。解方程：8x+18=11x+3，15=3x，所以x=5。最终答案：5。
